releaseNotes:
PRVN Music v0.15.0 (Build 19):
- Universal Native In-App Updater with background download, byte counters, speed, ETA, pause/resume, cancel & SHA-256 integrity verification.
- High-contrast button typography across dark and liquid glass themes.
- Full 16-state in-app update machine with unknown app installation permission handling.
- Complete eradication of upstream SimpMusic branding leaks across all screens, receipts, and localized languages.
- Elimination of Tidal HTTP 429 errors via LRU cache, deduplication, and circuit-breaker backoff.
- All 17 official reference logos preserved with in-app launcher icon switching.
- Production keystore pipeline with v1/v2/v3 signing schemes enabled.
